title: I am SHOCKED by this SEKA Gravel Bike!  *SEKA ExAERO GR*

takeaways.text: The size-56 build with SRAM Force XPLR, Drive G42 wheels, 29×2.2 in tires, pedals, power meter, cages and mount weighed 8.61 kg.

His 48T ring left enough room that he thinks a 52T would fit with spacing; a front-derailleur mount allows 2×. 29×2.2 in tires (about 55 mm by his estimate) fitted front and rear with room at the stays, above SEKA's 52 mm rear rating.
He found the reach comfortable at 25 mm of spacers with a 120 mm stem, and the long, shallow Gladius drops a comfortable alternative position on straight roads.
No paint on any mounting surface, a cleanly chased outboard T47 shell and brake mounts that aligned easily; titanium hardware throughout and a proprietary alloy out-front mount.

disclosure: Build walkaround by a US shop-owner YouTuber; how the frameset was obtained is not stated.
summary: Size-56 SEKA ExAero GR built with SRAM Force XPLR and 29×2.2 in mountain-bike tires, with a weigh-in and clearance walkaround.
